 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Real Madrid visit El Sardinero for the first time in more than a decade. Los Blancos will be without Fede Valverde, who is still recovering from the injury he suffered during El Clásico. Vinicius will also serve the third game on his four-match suspension.
 PREDICTED LINEUPS 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Racing Santander predicted XI: Agirrezabala; Mantilla, Pablo Ramón, Belocian, Aarón Martín; Iván Martín, Almeida; Pablo García, Canales, Iñigo Vicente; Zabiri
 Real Madrid predicted XI: Courtois; Dumfries, Konaté, Rüdiger, Carreras; Tchouaméni, Bernardo Silva; Güler, Bellingham, Diomande; Mbappé.
 HOW TO WATCH, STREAM LA LIGA 
 Date : 11/01/2026
 Time : 16:15 CET, 10:15am EST.
 Venue : El Sardinero, Santander, Spain.
 Available TV : DAZN La Liga (Spain), ESPN Deportes (USA).
 Available Streaming : ESPN+ (USA)
